reply.text:
Getting lean for summer is a solid target, and the split is the engine's job, not something I'll write out here. I'll build you a program around cutting for summer, and the app puts a "Build it" button under this reply. If you tell me how many days a week you can train and what equipment you have, it'll fit your life better.

On the general side, most people keep lifting heavy while they get lean, with the cardio and eating dialed in around it. Tell me your days and I'll point the build the right way.
